name: Context windows (latent frame windowing)
plain: Runs the model over overlapping frame windows and fuses, so a video model can sample more frames than its context. Each step makes as many model calls as windows. Core offers flat, pyramid and overlap-linear weights, plus relative for static schedules, with several window schedules.
math:
Windows from schedule (standard_static, standard_uniform, looped_uniform, batched). Output frame = Σ w·out / Σ w; w pyramid = distance from edge.
Relative fuse: running average weighted by a per-index bias, floor 0.01, not divided by Σw at the end.

props.hook: add wrappers: PREPARE_SAMPLING, SAMPLER_SAMPLE; set context_handler in model options
props.architectures: Video models; core has per-dim handler
